topology: Two-port directional coupler formed by two symmetric S-bent waveguides. Each guide enters from the left at a separated vertical position, bends into a close parallel coupling region, then bends back out to the corresponding right-side port.
operation: The long parallel section enables evanescent coupling between the two guides; the S-bends provide low-loss access while preserving the two-through-port layout.
calibration: calibration.json maps the supplied 120 um by 4 um footprint to the image bounding box.

knob_response.reason: verify_knob_response requires an MZI delta_length response; this symmetric directional coupler has equal measured arm lengths, while coupling_length changes shared coupling geometry.

iterations.change_made: Initial two-path implementation; Path x/y convenience setters centered each path and produced an 8.88 um vertical bbox.
Adjusted bend radius, port separation, access length, and coupling length; retained centered-path placement, so vertical mismatch persisted.
Translated each Path from its actual first point to the requested port coordinate; bbox became 120.0 x 3.88 um and topology aligned.
Tested bend_radius=0.80 um for smoother image-like corners; it extended X beyond the 120 um footprint and introduced excess overlap, so retained the honest best at bend_radius=0.30 um.
